versions.changelog:
- Initial release of nostr-auth, enabling authentication to Nostr sign-in challenges (NIP-07 style) without requiring a wallet or browser extension.
- Supports signing kind-22242 AUTH challenge events using a secp256k1 (BIP-340) key derived from a local master secret.
- Optionally submits signed events to a service callback; includes dry-run and inspection options before submission.
- Provides a Node.js 20.19+ script for handling sign-in challenges via CLI.
- Focuses on security: all keys stay local, per-domain key derivation prevents cross-site tracking.
- Roadmap includes future support for NIP-98 HTTP Auth, NIP-42 relay AUTH, and NIP-05.
